# PCafe 2025 - Modern Web Platform

PCafe 2025 is a contemporary web platform showcasing advanced technology integration and data visualization capabilities.

## Company & Project Overview

**Company**: Prototype Cafe LLC  
**Project**: Modern web platform development using cutting-edge technologies  
**Focus**: IoT data visualization, event management, and content publishing  

## Technology Stack & Capabilities

### Frontend Technologies
- **React + TypeScript**: Modern, type-safe user interface development
- **Vite**: High-performance build tooling and development server
- **Redux Toolkit + Saga**: Professional state management for complex applications
- **Radix UI**: Accessible, customizable component library
- **D3.js & Chart.js**: Advanced data visualization and interactive charts
- **React Admin**: Professional admin interface with CRUD operations

### Backend Technologies  
- **Go (Golang)**: High-performance, concurrent backend services
- **PostgreSQL**: Enterprise-grade relational database
- **TimescaleDB**: Specialized time-series database for IoT data at scale
- **REST API**: Clean, well-documented API architecture
- **Swagger/OpenAPI**: Comprehensive API documentation

### Data & Performance
- **Large-scale Data Processing**: Capable of handling 50M+ time-series records
- **IoT Data Management**: Real-time temperature, CO2, and environmental monitoring
- **Time-series Optimization**: Efficient querying and visualization of temporal data
- **Responsive Design**: Mobile-first, multi-device compatibility

### Security & Quality
- **Session-based Authentication**: Secure user management
- **Cloudflare Turnstile**: Advanced spam protection
- **Input Validation**: Comprehensive data sanitization
- **TypeScript**: Type safety across the entire application stack

## Business Applications

### Event Management Platform
- **Automated Event Discovery**: OCR and metadata extraction from images/PDFs
- **Calendar Integration**: Comprehensive event scheduling and management
- **Multi-format Content**: Support for various media types and formats

### Content Management System
- **Blog Platform**: Modern publishing with Markdown/HTML support
- **SEO Optimization**: Search engine friendly architecture
- **Admin Interface**: User-friendly content management tools

### IoT Data Visualization
- **Real-time Monitoring**: Live environmental data tracking
- **Interactive Charts**: Zoom, pan, and detailed data exploration
- **Historical Analysis**: Long-term trend analysis and reporting

### Contact & Communication
- **Professional Contact Forms**: Spam-protected inquiry management
- **Responsive Customer Interface**: Optimized for all device types

## Technical Strengths

- **Scalability**: Architecture designed for growth and high traffic
- **Performance**: Optimized for fast loading and smooth user experience  
- **Maintainability**: Clean code structure with comprehensive documentation
- **Modern Standards**: Following current industry best practices
- **Cross-platform**: Compatible across different devices and browsers

## Development Approach

- **Quality Assurance**: Comprehensive testing and validation processes
- **Documentation**: Well-documented codebase and API specifications
- **Responsive Design**: Mobile-first, accessible user interfaces
- **Containerization**: Docker-based development and deployment
- **CI/CD**: Automated testing and deployment pipelines

This project demonstrates expertise in modern web development, data management, and user experience design, suitable for enterprise-level applications requiring scalability, performance, and professional presentation.
